title: Remi Compact Cooling Centrifuges / Micro Centrifuges
desc: These newly developed compact bench top Cooling Centrifuges models CM-8 Plus and CM-12 Plus offers quiet operation with very small footprint. Centrifuge model CM-8 Plus is suitable for routine sample analysis in Medical, Hospital, Pathology and Institutional laboratories. With a wide choice of rotor heads and adaptors, this unit is truly versatile.
